summary: @onereach/ui-components-vue2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and auto-executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB script marked with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style array-shuffle string encoding and hex-mangled identifiers (e.g. `function WV8StW(arr){ for(...) MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()); return MmgoCP }` over a >1000-element mixed hex/string table). The payload's name (`math_init`) has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a Vue 2 component library), the payload's content is not human-inspectable in place, and it is unconditionally auto-executed on `npm install` via the fetched alternate runtime — bypassing Node-based install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
